comments.author: Pirotess
comments.body:
Hamburg is of German origins, both as it regards the language and the name. During the game's age however, it was under the Danish sovereignty. In any case not Dutch.

By the way, sadly there isn't the Shopkeeper's list of the items on the current template. I confirm that Plate Armors can be bought here after investing 400k.
